sonnet.problem: Card 18 asks again about the fact card 13 already asked: whether Esau accepts the gift right away or only after Jacob presses him. Card 14 ('Jacob insists') and card 17 ('arguing over who has to keep the gift') have also already shown that Jacob pushes the gift on Esau, so the card is close to a giveaway.
sonnet.rule: An easy follow-up asks something new. It never re-asks the same fact. Two lines that make the same point get one question. An answer shown on one card, right or wrong, isn't used again on a later card.
